title: Cybernetic Floral Entity
description: A female figure with pale gray skin covered in glowing circuit patterns looks downward with closed eyes. Her elaborate braided hair flows upward in vibrant green, purple, and black strands interwoven with pink, yellow, and white flowers, while her hands with long yellow nails manipulate three glowing circular holographic orbs containing a flower, an eye, and a masked face.
prompt: A surreal cybernetic female figure with pale gray skin and glowing circuit board patterns across her face and body, head tilted down with eyes closed, long intricate green and black braids flowing upward like energy, adorned with pink plumeria and yellow flowers, wearing a dark garment, hands with bright yellow nails manipulating three glowing circular holographic interfaces containing a flower, an alien eye, and a masked face, surrounded by thorny vines and abstract spiral symbols in a dark ethereal background
